title: PALISADE human assurance assertion v2
description: A signed statement about how much verified human evidence backed one interaction, bound to one audience and one thing on one surface: a request, the content of a message, or an interval of a call channel. It carries no subject identity, no biometric material, no device identifier and no cross-site identifier. The specified ladder reaches level 5; a verifier rejects any level it cannot itself verify.

assurance_level.description: 0 unattributed, 1 verified interaction evidence, 2 plus interactive liveness, 3 plus a device-bound credential, 4 plus an issuer assertion, 5 plus issuer-scoped uniqueness. A verifier refuses any level it cannot itself verify.

assurance_sources.description: The evidence classes the level rests on. A level must name every class up to it and must not name a class belonging to a level it does not claim.

uniqueness_scope.description: Global personhood is deliberately absent: an issuer can only dedupe within its own population.

binding.description: Ties the assertion to one audience and one thing on one surface. The profile says which fields are present; every other profile's fields must be absent, so a binding can never be read under the wrong profile. Field order is the canonical signing order.

profile.description: request: one action on the transaction surface, verified once before the action. content: one message, minted at send and verified at read by the recipient's client; validity may be days, and issued_at is the evidence age at send. channel: one interval of one call channel, re-issued every interval so presence is re-established rather than assumed.

session_binding.description: Opaque per-audience session commitment. It is derived so the same session is unlinkable across audiences and cannot be reversed to the session identifier.

content_commitment.description: content profile only. base64url SHA-256 of the message content, computed by the sender. PALISADE signs the commitment and never sees the content; forwarding the message with the assertion fails, because the binding is to what was sent.

channel_binding.description: channel profile only. Opaque per-audience channel commitment, derived like the session binding so the same channel is unlinkable across audiences.

interval_index.description: channel profile only. The re-attestation interval this assertion covers.

audience.description: Relying-party scope the assertion is valid for. It also salts the session and channel bindings.

issued_at.description: Evidence time. On the content profile this is the evidence age at the moment of sending, which a recipient must show separately from validity.

expires_at.description: Validity bound. At most five minutes after issued_at for the request profile, seven days for content, two minutes for channel.

key_id.description: Identifies the signing key without revealing it: the first eight bytes of the SHA-256 of the public key, hex encoded.
